comments.text:
Ryan editorial lock (2026-09-09 chat):

- Fully Pilobolus: Meta treats human employees like cheap AI models.
- Baseline we already know: Google/Apple process private photos/email with ML models.
- Cut: Meta acts like it doesn't matter that private info was revealed to human labelers, because those workers don't really count — worker side of the corp world, not customer side.
- Story is about that dehumanization, NOT privacy effects for privileged customers.
- Stage: research/reporting; no copywriting. Prior witness draft parked (wrong center).
- Notes updated in stories/PILO-280ead…/idea.md, assignment.md, research.md.

- Industry pattern yes: Sama, Scale/Remotasks, Appen feed Meta, OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Amazon; Apple via Scale client list + Filipino Remotasks annotators saying Apple image work.
- Strongest twins: OpenAI+Sama Kenya (TIME <$2/hr trauma labeling). Google Gemini raters (Guardian/WIRED) — often US GlobalLogic but same “humans make the model smart / then disposable” slot; also named in Kenya HITL coverage.
- Apple: in the stack, thinner intimate-content exposé trail than Meta/OpenAI.
- Filed 6 new keepers; research.md updated. Still research stage, no copy.
